searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: What you'd type into Google Maps, e.g. dentist, plumber, coffee shop.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region or ZIP, e.g. Austin, TX. Leave empty if your search terms already include it.

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search term
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Google Maps lists up to ~120 places per search; split big areas into several locations or terms.

extractContacts.title: Extract emails & socials from websites
extractContacts.description: Visits each business website (home + contact/about pages) for emails, phones and social profiles.

startUrls.title: Google Maps search URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Direct Google Maps search URLs, used in addition to search terms.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy works for most runs; switch to residential if you see blocks.
